products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as a provider of trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across healthcare and life sciences. The company was formerly known as Watson Health. Its portfolio spans clinical decision support, enterprise imaging, clinical data management, real-world evidence, and health data analytics, serving providers, payers, researchers, and life sciences organizations.

Its named products include Micromedex, a clinical decision support solution aimed at point-of-care insights; Zelta, a cloud-based clinical data management and acquisition platform designed for clinical trials; the Merge suite of enterprise imaging tools, including Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo described as 2025 Best in KLAS ranked; and Truven, which provides health data, analytics, and consulting services. The company also offers a real-world evidence portfolio described as a premium collection of data, services, and applications. One customer cited a jump from a 17% to 80% auto-renewal rate for MAGI Medicaid, along with 36,000 hours in time savings and nearly $1.3 million in cost savings in one cohort.

The site's held facts categorize Merative under Healthcare and Life Sciences AI, with noted capabilities in healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
